in_sanskrit.name: शश्वत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit name Shashwat is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shash' meaning 'eternal' and 'vat' meaning 'flow'. This name signifies the eternal flow of life and the endless cycle of existence.

in_hindi.name: शश्वत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Shashwat is a combination of two words - 'shashan' meaning 'rule, government' and 'vat' meaning 'flow'. This name signifies the one who rules the eternal flow of life or the one who governs the endless cycle of existence.

in_tamil.name: சசவத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Shashwat is derived from the Tamil words 'cacchi' meaning 'eternal' and 'vat' meaning 'flow'. This name signifies the eternal flow of life and the endless cycle of existence.
